days.plan: Land at JFK, check in at Fairfield Central Park (538 W 58th St). Evening walk to Columbus Circle / Rockefeller Center / Times Square. No timed booking on arrival day (Presidents' Day / NYCPS Midwinter Recess; most Broadway shows are dark Monday).

The Met Fifth Avenue (tentative visit; official hours and reported Wednesday closure unconfirmed, F-31), followed by Central Park walk south back to 59th St. Optional dinner: Jean-Georges (2-star, steps away, 6-course $298 pp) or Daniel (1-star, open Tue, $195 pp).

MoMA morning (open daily 10:30-17:30; 2-star The Modern sits inside for lunch $115 or Impressions dinner $185). Late-afternoon timed Top of the Rock slot (08:00-24:00) for sunset. Optional 2-star dinner at Gabriel Kreuther (open Wed, Pre-Theatre $155 or Tasting $325).

Morning Statue of Liberty ferry (09:00-16:30, last statue entry 15:30; weather/wind permitting), then 9/11 Memorial & Museum (Wed-Mon 09:00-19:00, last entry 18:00). Optional Tribeca/FiDi dinner: Jungsik (3-star, $335), Saga (2-star, $215), Crown Shy (1-star ALC ~$75), or One White Street (Green Star $145).

The High Line (winter hours 07:00-20:00) and Chelsea Market (07:00-22:00) by day. Evening centerpiece: Le Bernardin Chef's Tasting (3-star, $350 pp, open Fri 17:00-23:00; 16-min walk or 1 subway stop from hotel).

Early Brooklyn Bridge pedestrian walkway (open 24h) into DUMBO. Evening: Gabriel Kreuther (2-star, open Sat 16:45-22:00, Tasting $325 pp) — or value highlights Dirt Candy (1-star Green Star, $118 pp no-tip) / Cote (1-star, $84 pp Butcher's Feast).

American Museum of Natural History (10:00-17:30 daily, $37 pp out-of-state) or harbour weather-swap buffer. Note Le Bernardin, Gabriel Kreuther, Jean-Georges & Dirt Candy close Sundays; Sunday-open stars include The Modern (2-star), Saga (2-star), EMP (3-star), Jungsik (3-star), Per Se (3-star), Sushi Sho (3-star), Gramercy Tavern (1-star) & Cote (1-star).
Breakfast included at hotel, check out, transfer to JFK.
